requirements.name: Embedded DSP in C/C++

lines.quote: The control and sequencing logic runs in C on an ARM Cortex-M4 board, handling real-time stimulus generation and response capture under deterministic timing constraints.

requirements.note: Describes embedded C control/sequencing logic for a hardware-in-the-loop test sequencer rather than explicitly signal-processing algorithms; whether this satisfies the requirement's domain is a judgement call for the recruiter.

lines.quote: Built a Python-based data pipeline for processing and archiving test measurements from the sequencer. The system ingests raw data, applies correction factors, generates compliance reports, and archives results to a shared database. Approximately 6,000 lines of Python, maintained under version control with automated tests, used by the verification team (four engineers) for daily production work.
